title: Initial face and final edge admit a finite inner-horn filtration
statement: Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and inner horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and colimits of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For a subset $S\subseteq[n]$, let $\Delta^S\subseteq\Delta^n$ consist of the monotone maps with image contained in $S$. For every integer $n>0$, put $T=\Delta^{\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}$, $I=\Delta^{\{n-1,n\}}$, and $K=T\cup I\subseteq\Delta^n$. There is a finite filtration $K=K_0\subseteq K_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq K_N=\Delta^n$ in which every $K_{j-1}\hookrightarrow K_j$ is a pushout of an inner horn inclusion $\Lambda^{d_j}_{a_j}\hookrightarrow\Delta^{d_j}$, with $d_j\geq2$ and $0<a_j<d_j$. Each pushout is computed degreewise in sets. The case $n=1$ permits $N=0$.
